name: The Largest Text Step Fits The Board; High Contrast Is High
note: D9 (2026-11-06). The board half reads the digit back against the board's width, so a step that never reached the board fails instead of passing on a normal board; the contrast half checks each theme with the switch off too, so a switch that does nothing fails.

mutations.name: the board ignores the text step
mutations.why: The setting would change the app's text and leave the digits — the part players asked to read — as they were.

mutations.name: the digit cap rises to 1.3
mutations.why: Measured: the digit font's 1.4em text box is 44.5px in a 41px cell at 1.3.
mutations.expectFailure: cells overflow at the largest step

mutations.name: the note cap rises to 1.3
mutations.why: Expected to survive, and the audit of 2026-11-06 showed it: this gate measures layout boxes, and a note's text box is taller than its slot even at the normal step (81 of 108 killer notes), so it cannot tell a note crossing the dashed cage line from one that does not. The 1.15 cap is a margin by arithmetic (about 11.8px of note in 11.3px of room at 1.3), held by gate 2-34. Kept so the limit of this gate stays written down.

mutations.name: high contrast leaves the clay grid lines as they were
mutations.why: The light themes draw the thin lines at about 1.8:1 on white — the thing high contrast is for.
mutations.expectFailure: clay: with high contrast the grid lines are

mutations.name: high contrast leaves the notes muted
mutations.why: Notes are the smallest text on the board; with high contrast on they take the main text colour.
mutations.expectFailure: notes should take the main text colour

mutations.name: the box lines stay thin
mutations.why: The box lines are what a player follows across the board; with high contrast on they go from 2.5 to 3.5px.
mutations.expectFailure: the box lines did not get thicker

mutations.name: the preview is drawn outside a board container
mutations.why: The digits are sized from the board container's width (cqw). Outside one they size from the nearest other container and the preview stops showing the board's proportion.
